# Brilliant Nodes

> Brilliant Nodes runs node, validator and launch-day infrastructure for new blockchain networks, and builds apps that use what each blockchain does best.

## What we do
- Launch-day capacity: rented machines brought online within hours of a network launch, across several providers.
- Seed and hub nodes: permanent servers in Europe, North America and Asia that our machines and outside users sync from.
- Validator operations: we take part in the validator programmes of GenLayer, Flop Network and gno.land, with separate owner and operator keys and full monitoring.
- Development: apps and contract building blocks on GenLayer, each with public code, a live demo and a written article. All demos use fictional companies and test tokens only.

## Pages
- [Home](https://www.brilliantnodes.com/): services, servers, development work, research, validators and contact
- [Validators and nodes](https://www.brilliantnodes.com/validators.html): the nodes we run, our validator programmes, how we run them, launch-day preparation
- [Our GenLayer work](https://www.brilliantnodes.com/genlayer.html): every GenLayer app and building block, with code, demos, contracts and articles
- [Questions and answers](https://www.brilliantnodes.com/faq.html): short answers about who we are, our networks, servers, security and apps
- [Security](https://www.brilliantnodes.com/security.html): how we keep keys, servers and software safe, and how to report a problem

## Development projects (GenLayer)
- [Launch Claim Checker](https://checker.brilliantnodes.com/): checks a new coin's launch claims against its block explorer
- [ClaimEscrow](https://claims.brilliantnodes.com/): escrow for buying and selling bankruptcy claims
- [PrivateCreditGate](https://privatecredit.brilliantnodes.com/): loan covenant checks from a borrower's published report
- [RigSettle](https://rigsettle.brilliantnodes.com/): escrow for renting mining power, split by hashrate delivered
- [Code](https://github.com/brilliantnodes): all public on GitHub
